BrochureContent.Content:
John Giltinane & Associates are delighted to bring this 3 Bedroom home to the market for sale.

Located just off Main Street, Pallaskenry, and situated along a quiet cul-de-sac, this property presents an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a renovation project with significant potential.

The accommodation currently comprises three bedrooms, one bathroom, a kitchen and a living room.

A particularly attractive feature of the property is that it has been approved for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant and also benefits from planning permission, offering purchasers an exciting opportunity to renovate, extend and transform the property into a modern home.

Its location offers the perfect balance of a peaceful and private setting while remaining within easy walking distance of the amenities of Pallaskenry village, including shops, schools and local services.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a property with substantial potential in a highly convenient and quiet residential location.
